title: Comprehensive assessment of estrogenic activities of parabens by in silico approach and in vitro assays.
authors: Wei, Fang; Cheng, Hefa; Sang, Nan
journal: The Science of the total environment
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟和结合自由能计算研究尼泊金酯与雌激素受体的结合机制，对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法虽含物理模拟但与本课题TF-DNA体系无关。
abstract: Parabens are ubiquitous pollutants in the environment and humans due to their wide applications in food, pharmaceuticals, and personal care products. Although the estrogenic activity of some parabens has been confirmed, the underlying mechanisms and the structure-estrogenic activity relationship are still largely unclear. Here, we systematically used in silico and in vitro approaches to investigate the estrogenic potency of typical parabens, including methyl-, ethyl-, propyl-, iso-propyl-, butyl-, iso-butyl- and benzyl-paraben. Molecular dynamics simulations and binding free energy calculations were combined to investigate the atomic-level mechanism of paraben binding to estrogen receptors (ERs). Computational analysis showed that ER were the targets of tested parabens and kept a stable agonist conformation. The calculated total binding free energies suggested that van der Waals interactions were the major driving forces for paraben-ER interaction and correlated with the structure of paraben side chains. In in vitro assays, paraben with an aromatic side chain, benzyl-paraben, showed the strongest estrogenic activity at 0.01 muM and the EC(50) at 0.796 +/- 0.307 muM, on par with levels commonly detected in human organs. Among tested parabens with an alkyl side chain, the estrogenicity increased as the side chain length increased from 1 to 4, but no significant difference appeared between parabens with isomeric alkyl side chains (propyl- vs isopropyl and butyl- vs iso-butylparaben). The estrogenic activity of parabens was significantly related to the calculated binding energies (R(2) = 0.94, p = 0.0012), depending on the side chains of parabens. Our findings provide a significant mechanism for parabens to disrupt estrogenic function and considerations for structural optimization from the perspective of environmental protection.
abstract_zh: 对羟基苯甲酸酯（parabens）因其在食品、药品和个人护理产品中的广泛应用，成为环境和人体中普遍存在的污染物。尽管某些对羟基苯甲酸酯的雌激素活性已被证实，但其潜在机制及结构-雌激素活性关系仍 largely 不清楚。在此，我们系统性地采用计算机模拟（in silico）和体外（in vitro）方法研究了典型对羟基苯甲酸酯（包括甲基、乙基、丙基、异丙基、丁基、异丁基和苄基对羟基苯甲酸酯）的雌激素效力。结合分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟和结合自由能计算，探讨了对羟基苯甲酸酯与雌激素受体（ERs）结合的原子级机制。计算分析表明，ER是所测对羟基苯甲酸酯的靶标，并保持稳定的激动剂构象。计算的总结合自由能显示，范德华相互作用是对羟基苯甲酸酯-ER相互作用的主要驱动力，且与其侧链结构相关。在体外实验中，具有芳香侧链的对羟基苯甲酸酯（苄基对羟基苯甲酸酯）在0.01 μM浓度下表现出最强的雌激素活性，其EC(50)为0.796 ± 0.307 μM，与人体器官中常见水平相当。在具有烷基侧链的测试对羟基苯甲酸酯中，雌激素活性随侧链长度从1增至4而增强，但异构烷基侧链（丙基与异丙基、丁基与异丁基对羟基苯甲酸酯）之间无显著差异。对羟基苯甲酸酯的雌激素活性与计算结合能显著相关（R(2) = 0.94，p = 0.0012），且取决于其侧链结构。我们的发现为对羟基苯甲酸酯干扰雌激素功能提供了重要机制，并从环境保护角度为结构优化提供了考虑因素。
